# Vendored: html2canvas

- **Version:** 1.4.1
- **Source:** https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
- **Licence:** MIT — see `LICENSE` in this directory (Copyright © 2022 Niklas von Hertzen)
- **Used by:** `assets/annotate.js`, to turn the annotated page into an image.

Served by the UAT helper at `/vendor/html2canvas.min.js`; never inlined into the
generated checklist HTML. Not edited here — replace the file wholesale to upgrade.

**Known limitation:** html2canvas re-renders the DOM into a canvas rather than
photographing the screen, so canvas/WebGL content, cross-origin images and some
CSS come out wrong. This is why the annotator shows the tester a preview and asks
"does this look like what you saw?" before sending.
